preconditions.description: The number of volumes is between 1 and 100000, inclusive.

postconditions.description: The output contains exactly n numbers.

postconditions.expression: all(1 <= output[i] <= n for i in range(n))
postconditions.description: Each number in the output is between 1 and n, inclusive.

postconditions.expression: all(output[i] != output[j] for i in range(n) for j in range(i + 1, n))
postconditions.description: The output contains no duplicate numbers.

postconditions.expression: min(count_divisors(sum(1 for i in range(n) if output[i] % j == 0 and i + 1 % j == 0)) for j in range(1, n + 1)) == min(count_divisors(sum(1 for i in range(n) if output[i] % j == 0 and i + 1 % j == 0)) for j in range(1, n + 1))
postconditions.description: The output minimizes the number of divisors of the sum of 1 for each i such that output[i] % j == 0 and i + 1 % j == 0.
